purpose: Learn pre-race L1 expert routing by betting-role usefulness rather than literal finish-position columns.
granularity: one race x role x expert x top_n candidate

roles.ANCHOR: candidate set captures a valid winner
roles.MAINLINE: candidate set captures at least one of the valid 2nd/3rd podium opponents
roles.COVER: candidate set captures both valid 2nd/3rd podium opponents

principles: Do not treat literal 2nd and 3rd positions as separate responsibilities for MAINLINE/COVER.
MAINLINE rewards useful opponent capture regardless of whether that horse finished 2nd or 3rd.
COVER rewards complete capture of both podium opponents at a fixed candidate size.
Compare routers only against fixed experts at the same TopN candidate cost.
Dead heats are represented by all valid ordered podium outcomes.
